title: Anna Paulina Luna on Joe Rogan: read the Book of Enoch for UAP origins
summary: Anna Paulina Luna tells of Anna Paulina Luna on Joe Rogan: read the Book of Enoch for UAP origins, about 2020s at The Joe Rogan Experience, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Okay, so if you read it, it talks about the fall of angels, um, thus creating really the precursor of civilization that led to the first flood.

plain: A US congresswoman, Anna Paulina Luna, said on Joe Rogan's popular podcast in the 2020s that people wondering where unexplained flying objects come from should read the Book of Enoch, an ancient religious text. She says it tells of the fall of angels, which she describes as the start of a civilization that came before the first great flood. If her reading holds, it would tie today's sightings to very old stories of beings from above.
